summary: Mission objective unit lists run through their reconstructed bodies. Objectives_AddUnit / Objectives_RemoveUnit (Lua natives) call 008CDD60 / 008CE510; the unit targets of Objectives_Add and AddUnit go through 008DF2B0 (record 008DEE50); Objectives_Completed / Failed run the 008DFE50 walk; removals erase entries with 008DC3E0. The chain-152 position list becomes the whole objective+20h list (units and positions in push order) and GameObjectiveSets::Objective::units is its unit projection. Body fixes: 008CDD60/008CE510 test arguments 0/1 with 00B66A60 IsInteger (was is_nil); the removal hooks and the add tail take the set slot the native passes in ECX (008CEB55, 008CEBD1, 008DFE74, 008DF3D7).
behaviour_changes_on: AddUnit on an objective the slot does not hold adds nothing (008DF2B0 returns); the old host created the objective.
AddUnit / RemoveUnit with neither an integer party nor an integer slot select no set (mask starts 0 at 008CDD8B); the old host used slot 0.
An explicit slot applies only when that player is active (008CDF58), i.e. slot 0 in single player; the old host accepted slots 1..7.
A unit with +5Dh set (GameUnitsHost::unit_flag_005d) is not added (008DF2B0's liveness test).
A unit added twice is listed twice (008DEE50 has no duplicate test); a removal erases every entry of the unit (008DC3E0).
RemoveUnit position targets now erase matching position entries (008DDD30 / 008DC500 rule); the old host ignored them.
Add's targets are pushed in visit order (unit and position interleaved) instead of all positions then all units.
